Boot SDK user guide

2 Overview


2                      Overview
The PSOC™ 64 Secure Boot MCU line, based on the PSOC™ 6 MCU platform, features out-of-box security
functionality. This line provides an isolated Root of Trust (RoT) with true attestation and provisioning services.
Additionally, these MCUs offer a pre-configured secure execution environment that supports system software
for various IoT platforms and provides:
•    Secure provisioning
